 Kate Middleton Pairs a Black Turtleneck with a Hard Hat for Visit to a Construction Site 
 The Princess returned to The Treehouse hospice which she officially opened in 2012.
 By Victoria Murphy Published: Oct 22, 2026 9:11 AM EDT Save Article Share Article WPA Pool // Getty Images 2 min read The Princess of Wales wore an unexpected outfit today for an official visit to a children’s hospice. Kate put on a hard hat and an orange high-vis jacket to see construction work being done at The Treehouse hospice in Ipswich to create a new hydrotherapy pool and other expanded facilities.
 CHRIS RADBURN // Getty Images The Princess of Wales walking with Mark Pendlington, the Lord-Lieutenant of Suffolk, during her visit. The Treehouse, which is run by charity East Anglia’s Children’s Hospices, holds special memories for Kate. It was there that she delivered her first speech as a royal in March 2012 to officially open the venue. Not a natural public speaker, she was visibly nervous as she took to the podium to make her remarks almost one year after marrying William.
 In 2012, Kate wore a royal blue Reiss dress with black pumps and a black clutch, both by Stuart Weitzman.
 WPA Pool // Getty Images The then-Duchess of Cambridge was seen planting a tree at the opening.
 Ian Gavan // Getty Images Today, she was the picture of composure as she teamed a Victoria Beckham outfit with protective clothing to take a tour of the hospice and its facilities and meet with children and their families. She was pictured kneeling down to talk to children and hugging some of the 185 young people and family members who currently receive support from the hospice.
 CHRIS RADBURN // Getty Images Kate views the construction site for the expansion of the The Treehouse. “EACH’s aim is to ensure the best possible quality of life for babies, children and young people” Kensington Palace said in a statement. “Families want their children to enjoy life, and EACH believes every young person, including those receiving hospice care, needs the same things to thrive – friendship, fun, family time, activities and laughter.”
 WPA Pool // Getty Images Kate meets with family members of patients at The Treehouse. WPA Pool // Getty Images The princess attends a music therapy session with children at the hospice. EACH was one of the first charities that Kate became Patron of in early 2012. Her visit today follows her appearance on Tuesday at the State Banquet in Windsor in honor of the Sultan of Oman.
